#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Full local gate: fresh import + every trusted probe.  Probe user data is
# isolated so one bot cannot make the next bot pass by pre-winning content.
set -uo pipefail
GODOT="${GODOT:-godot}"
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
# Windows-local parity (2026-08-04): on Windows the Python default text codec
# is cp1252, so every tool below that reads a UTF-8 source file or prints an
# arrow/em-dash dies with a charmap error and the suite never reaches the
# probes. Linux CI already defaults to UTF-8, so this is a no-op there.
export PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8"
export PYTHONUTF8=1
RUNTIME_ERROR_RE='SCRIPT ERROR|Invalid assignment of property or key|The tweened property .* does not exist|ERROR:.*(Failed loading resource|Cannot open file|No loader found|Resource file not found)'
FAILURE_RE='FAIL|FAILED|ISSUE|TIMEOUT|STUCK|DID NOT|MISSING|SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Compile Error'
python3 tools/audit_document_authority.py || exit 1
python3 tools/audit_development.py --base auto || exit 1
python3 -m gdtoolkit.parser scripts/games/dust_boss.gd scripts/probe_dust_boss.gd || exit 1
python3 tools/lint_inference.py scripts/games/dust_boss.gd scripts/probe_dust_boss.gd || exit 1
python3 tools/audit_game_2d.py --regression-gate \
	|| { echo "GAME-WIDE 2D MIGRATION REGRESSION (debt may only shrink)"; exit 1; }
rc=0
for p in probe_reef_districts probe_ocean_kingdoms probe_audit probe_passive probe_living_world probe_load probe_rank probe_save_recovery probe_galaxy_state probe_collection probe_mg2d probe_fetch probe_melody probe_dolls probe_seek probe_audio probe_dance probe_l2 probe_l2_living_cards probe_sky_lagoon_animals probe_l2_reenter probe_crown probe_throne probe_northern probe_human_art_audit probe_train probe_verbs probe_skins probe_touch_router probe_touch_stress probe_interaction probe_touch_adversary probe_touch_look probe_ui_system probe_voice probe_day_one_voice probe_day_one_d8_revisits probe_day_one_handoffs probe_kart_feel probe_combat probe_dust_bunny probe_dust_bunny_boss probe_dust_boss probe_hit probe_partner probe_combat_tutorial probe_imp_ai probe_mic probe_stuffie probe_dungeon probe_ember probe_opera probe_opera_2d probe_opera_diegetic_paths probe_opera_detective probe_opera_pipe probe_opera_nursery probe_opera_gesture_quality probe_kitchen_props probe_bathroom_props probe_castle_door_language probe_bathroom_integration probe_day_one_bathroom_bunny probe_day_one_bathroom_cleanup probe_day_one_bathroom_movie_handoff probe_day_one_director probe_day_one_integration probe_day_one_pool_cleanup probe_day_one_art_attack_state probe_day_one_castle_dressing probe_day_one_story_clips probe_chapter2 probe_chapter2_farmer_resume probe_chapter2_lawn probe_alpha_milestone_save probe_dust_boss_balance probe_start_menu_routing probe_start_menu_new_game probe_castle_pool_life_2d probe_castle_pearl_art probe_fairy_art probe_props; do
	[ -f "scripts/$p.gd" ] || { echo "PROBE $p MISSING: scripts/$p.gd is required"; rc=1; continue; }
	echo "=== $p ==="
	probe_home="$(mktemp -d)"
	mkdir -p "$probe_home/data" "$probe_home/config" \
		"$probe_home/appdata" "$probe_home/localappdata"
	probe_appdata="$probe_home/appdata"
	probe_localappdata="$probe_home/localappdata"
	if command -v cygpath >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		# Godot's Windows build uses APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA, not XDG_*.
		# Native paths keep one probe's save from pre-winning the next probe.
		probe_appdata="$(cygpath -w "$probe_appdata")"
		probe_localappdata="$(cygpath -w "$probe_localappdata")"
	fi
	probe_output="$probe_home/$p.out"
	touch_test_mode="--classic-touch-test"
	case "$p" in
		probe_passive|probe_touch_router|probe_touch_stress|probe_interaction|probe_touch_adversary)
			touch_test_mode="--hybrid-touch-test"
			;;
	esac
	probe_rc=0
	APPDATA="$probe_appdata" LOCALAPPDATA="$probe_localappdata" \
		XDG_DATA_HOME="$probe_home/data" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$probe_home/config" \
		timeout 8m "$GODOT" --headless -s "scripts/$p.gd" -- --touch "$touch_test_mode" 2>&1 | tee "$probe_output" || probe_rc=$?
	echo "PROBE $p process exit: $probe_rc"
	if [ "$probe_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
		# Known engine flaw (2026-07-18): Godot 4.4 sometimes deadlocks at EXIT
		# after a probe printed its complete verdict (seen after kart-heavy
		# probes, always AFTER an ALL OK line). Accept a timeout kill (124)
		# only when the transcript ends with a final verdict marker; the
		# failure greps below still veto bad content. Anything else is real.
		if [ "$probe_rc" -eq 124 ] && tail -n 5 "$probe_output" | grep -qE "ALL OK|RESULT"; then
			echo "PROBE $p reached its verdict; engine hung at exit and was reaped - accepted"
		else
			rc=1
		fi
	fi
	grep -qE "$FAILURE_RE" "$probe_output" \
		&& { echo "PROBE $p reported a failure or runtime script error"; rc=1; }
	# a script that cannot compile leaves the probe waiting on a world that
	# never builds - bail on the whole gate instead of timing out per-probe
	grep -qE "Parse Error|Compile Error" "$probe_output" \
		&& { echo "PROBE $p hit a script compile error - aborting gate"; exit 1; }
	grep -qE "$RUNTIME_ERROR_RE" "$probe_output" \
		&& { echo "PROBE $p reported a resource or property runtime error"; rc=1; }
	# positive floor: a probe that exits 0 while printing nothing asserted
	# nothing - a startup crash swallowed before any output must not pass
	[ -s "$probe_output" ] \
		|| { echo "PROBE $p produced no output - silent no-op treated as failure"; rc=1; }
	rm -rf "$probe_home"
done
exit $rc
